entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's not working.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a technical fault. The device is basically broken. It won't sync with my phone, no matter what I try. I think it's just a defective unit.

I'm very sorry to hear you're having that trouble. A band that won't sync is definitely not the experience we want for our members. I see you received the item 14 days ago. For a potentially defective device like this, our standard procedure is to connect you with our technical support team.
Look, I don't have time to sit on the phone troubleshooting. I just want a return label to send it back. Yes or no, can you do that?

I understand you're busy and want a direct answer. For a defect claim, the fastest way to a resolution is through our tech team. They can remotely diagnose if the hardware is broken, and if so, they can authorize an immediate replacement shipment, which is often quicker than processing a standard return and re-order.
A replacement is fine, as long as it's fast. I don't want to waste another hour on this.

Absolutely. And I can see you're a long-time VIP member with us. To apologize for the faulty device and the time this is taking, I'm going to add a $25 credit to your VeloFit account right now. You can use that on any future purchase.
Okay. That's fine. So, transfer me.

Of course. I've added the credit and made a note on your account for the tech team detailing the sync issue. They'll be ready for you. Is there anything else I can help with before I make the transfer?
Understood. Please hold for one moment while I connect you to our VeloBand technical specialists.
